absence_fields.name: creators
absence_fields.for: nobody is recorded as having made this, and a person has looked. spec-02 6.5's photographer case

absence_fields.name: credits
absence_fields.for: who is credited on this, where a person has established that nothing more is findable

absence_fields.name: time_span
absence_fields.for: when this was made or captured. spec-02 6.5's date case, which a scan of an undated letter reaches

absence_fields.name: digital_items
absence_fields.for: the household describes this and holds no file for it. Zero digital items establishes not_held on its own (spec-01 5.2); an assertion here says a person has decided no file will be found

absence_fields.name: assets
absence_fields.for: every stored copy is lost. Zero assets establishes not_held on its own (spec-01 5.5)

absence_fields.name: language
absence_fields.for: this name belongs to no language in the relevant sense, asserted rather than left null. spec-01 7.2 makes null mean absent and gives no column for unknown

absence_fields.name: loudness
absence_fields.for: integrated loudness in LUFS. The derived source is what makes not_yet_examined and attempted_failed distinguishable for a field, since a signal entirely below the absolute gate has no loudness to report
